## Problem and result

What user-visible problem does this solve, and what happens after the change?

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, including skips and limitations.
For documentation-only changes, check links and commands.
For installer changes, use the checks in AGENTS.md.

For runtime or Skill changes, report relevant layers separately:
model-free tests, real MCP generation, fresh-client discovery, automatic Skill
use, final integration and listening. Mark untested layers explicitly.

## Compatibility and preservation

If relevant, explain effects on existing settings, Skills, models and outputs,
and any platform behavior that was not verified. Do not attach credentials,
model weights, private configurations or unreviewed logs.
